General FAQs
5
All Content
What hours are the Wright County offices open?
Monday through Friday, 8:00 A.M. to 4:30 P.M., except for holidays. Please note: The Law Enforcement Center and Jail hours may vary.
General FAQs
Where can I find County Buildings?
The public county buildings are located in the city of Buffalo. Maps and addresses to the buildings are available on the county facilities page .
General FAQs
Where can I park when I visit the Government Center?
The Government Center Parking map shows where you can park when visiting the Government Center.
General FAQs
How can I find tax information for my property?
Use our online property search to find tax information on your property.
General FAQs
Can I pay my property taxes online?
Yes, property taxes can be paid online. To pay your property taxes online, first find your property using our online property search , then use the Pay Taxes button to pay online.
